description: Answer a slash command or interactive action through its response URL. handle is the callback_handle from that slack.event; body is a Slack message payload such as {"text": "Done", "response_type": "in_channel"} or {"replace_original": true, "text": "Approved"}.

team_id.description: Workspace: team_id from the slack.event. Needed only when this interface serves several workspaces.
